loft_drum_kit.name: Drum kit
loft_drum_kit.flavor: The neighbours have been very understanding. Outwardly.

loft_snare_stand.name: Practice snare on a stand
loft_snare_stand.flavor: Bought to learn quietly. It is not quiet.

loft_cello.name: Cello on its stand
loft_cello.flavor: Insured for more than the car, which is fair.

loft_double_bass.name: Double bass
loft_double_bass.flavor: Needs its own seat on the train. Has had one.

loft_guitar_amp.name: Valve guitar amp
loft_guitar_amp.flavor: Goes up to eleven. Stays at three for the flat below.

loft_music_stand.name: Folding music stand
loft_music_stand.flavor: Holds one page of Bach and a biscuit.

loft_metronome.name: Wind-up metronome
loft_metronome.flavor: Keeps better time than anyone in the band.

loft_mic_stand.name: Boom microphone stand
loft_mic_stand.flavor: Used twice for singing and daily for hanging a scarf.

loft_accordion.name: Piano accordion
loft_accordion.flavor: Comes out at weddings whether invited or not.

loft_floor_harp.name: Pedal harp
loft_floor_harp.flavor: Someone was meant to learn. The harp waits.

loft_trumpet_stand.name: Trumpet on a stand
loft_trumpet_stand.flavor: Polished more than played, which suits everyone.

loft_bongos.name: Pair of bongos
loft_bongos.flavor: Played once, at a party, and spoken of since.

loft_gong.name: Gong on a frame
loft_gong.flavor: Marks the end of meditation and the start of complaints.

loft_dj_decks.name: DJ decks and mixer
loft_dj_decks.flavor: Two turntables and a lifetime of saying 'one more'.

loft_reel_to_reel.name: Reel-to-reel tape deck
loft_reel_to_reel.flavor: Plays one tape, very beautifully, very slowly.

loft_mixing_desk.name: Recording mixing desk
loft_mixing_desk.flavor: Forty knobs, three of which do anything.

loft_vinyl_wall_shelf.name: Now-playing wall shelf
loft_vinyl_wall_shelf.flavor: Shows the record that is on. Mostly the same one.

loft_podcast_mic.name: Podcast microphone on an arm
loft_podcast_mic.flavor: Has heard every theory about the moon landings twice.

loft_paint_taboret.name: Artist's taboret on castors
loft_paint_taboret.flavor: Every drawer holds a tube of the wrong blue.

loft_canvas_rack.name: Canvas drying rack
loft_canvas_rack.flavor: Seven paintings, all of them nearly finished.

loft_brush_palette.name: Brush jar and palette
loft_brush_palette.flavor: The palette is a painting in itself, and better.

loft_lay_figure.name: Wooden lay figure
loft_lay_figure.flavor: Poses for nothing. Complains about nothing.

loft_drafting_table.name: Tilting drafting table
loft_drafting_table.flavor: Tilts to any angle, including the useful ones.

loft_pottery_wheel.name: Pottery wheel
loft_pottery_wheel.flavor: Everything made on it is technically a bowl.

loft_kiln.name: Studio kiln
loft_kiln.flavor: Reaches twelve hundred degrees and the electricity bill reaches further.

loft_etching_press.name: Etching press
loft_etching_press.flavor: Prints six lovely editions of the same heron.

loft_floor_loom.name: Floor loom
loft_floor_loom.flavor: Four metres of scarf so far, and no neck in mind.

loft_spinning_wheel.name: Spinning wheel
loft_spinning_wheel.flavor: Turns fleece into yarn and evenings into nights.

loft_printer_3d.name: 3D printer
loft_printer_3d.flavor: Prints small plastic boats. Nobody asked for the boats.

loft_soldering_station.name: Soldering station
loft_soldering_station.flavor: Smells of rosin and good intentions.

loft_maker_bench.name: Maker's workbench
loft_maker_bench.flavor: Clear for exactly one minute after tidying.

loft_wood_lathe.name: Wood lathe
loft_wood_lathe.flavor: Makes bowls, pens and a great deal of sawdust.

loft_treadmill.name: Folding treadmill
loft_treadmill.flavor: An expensive place to dry shirts.

loft_exercise_bike.name: Exercise bike
loft_exercise_bike.flavor: Has done four thousand miles without leaving the loft.

loft_dumbbell_rack.name: Dumbbell rack
loft_dumbbell_rack.flavor: Lifted daily, by the cleaner, to dust under.

loft_weight_bench.name: Adjustable weight bench
loft_weight_bench.flavor: Mostly used for sitting on to tie shoelaces.

loft_punchbag.name: Hanging punchbag
loft_punchbag.flavor: Takes everything personally and shows none of it.

loft_yoga_mat_roll.name: Rolled yoga mat
loft_yoga_mat_roll.flavor: Unrolled for downward dog, mostly by the actual dog.

loft_medicine_ball.name: Medicine ball
loft_medicine_ball.flavor: Prescribed by nobody, taken by nobody.

loft_wall_bars.name: Gymnastics wall bars
loft_wall_bars.flavor: Good for stretches and for drying a whole wash.

loft_hammock_stand.name: Hammock on a stand
loft_hammock_stand.flavor: The best seat in the loft and the hardest to leave.

loft_spiral_stairs.name: Spiral staircase kit
loft_spiral_stairs.flavor: Comes flat-packed. Leaves as a lifelong project.

loft_macrame_planter.name: Macrame hanging planter
loft_macrame_planter.flavor: Knotted in 1976. The spider plant is newer.

loft_tiered_plant_stand.name: Tiered plant stand
loft_tiered_plant_stand.flavor: Three shelves of plants, one of which is thriving.

loft_bonsai.name: Bonsai juniper
loft_bonsai.flavor: Forty years old and still not allowed out.

loft_book_trolley.name: Library book trolley
loft_book_trolley.flavor: Returned from the library in 1998, on its own wheels.

loft_pendant_cluster.name: Factory pendant lights
loft_pendant_cluster.flavor: Three enamel shades, all with an opinion on the dinner.

loft_neon_sign.name: Neon sign that says OPEN
loft_neon_sign.flavor: Never once true of the person who owns it.

loft_cast_radiator.name: Cast-iron column radiator
loft_cast_radiator.flavor: Takes an hour to warm and a day to cool down.

loft_factory_cart.name: Factory cart
loft_factory_cart.flavor: Once moved engine parts, now moves magazines.

loft_barber_chair.name: Old barber's chair
loft_barber_chair.flavor: Reclines with a clunk that could wake a street.

loft_pinball.name: Pinball machine
loft_pinball.flavor: Tilts if you look at it, which is sensible.

loft_table_football.name: Table football
loft_table_football.flavor: Spinning is banned, which has never stopped anyone.

loft_ping_pong_folded.name: Folded ping-pong table
loft_ping_pong_folded.flavor: Folded away for winter. Winter has lasted since 2015.

loft_model_railway.name: Model railway layout
loft_model_railway.flavor: The 8.15 has been late for eleven years.

loft_microscope.name: Brass microscope
loft_microscope.flavor: Has seen pond water up close and was not impressed.

loft_cine_projector.name: Cine film projector
loft_cine_projector.flavor: Shows the same holiday in 1974 every Christmas.

loft_projector_screen.name: Pull-down projector screen
loft_projector_screen.flavor: Pulled down for films and up for the cat.

loft_darkroom_enlarger.name: Darkroom enlarger
loft_darkroom_enlarger.flavor: Makes prints of the cat in very serious black and white.

loft_camera_tripod.name: Old camera on a tripod
loft_camera_tripod.flavor: Takes a portrait if everybody holds still for a week.

loft_backdrop_stand.name: Photo backdrop stand
loft_backdrop_stand.flavor: Grey paper roll for portraits. Everyone looks wanted.

loft_climbing_board.name: Climbing hold board
loft_climbing_board.flavor: Two metres of chalk and one route nobody has finished.

loft_surfboard.name: Longboard surfboard
loft_surfboard.flavor: Leans against the wall, dreaming of Cornwall.
